about.title: About me
about.description.first: I graduated in Digital Marketing and have over 3 years of hands-on experience in content writing, Canva design, and managing social media channels. My strengths include building content ideas for specific communication goals, designing cohesive brand materials, and tracking performance to optimize post quality over time.
about.description.second: I also have direct experience managing fanpages, creating weekly/monthly content plans, scheduling posts consistently, and collaborating flexibly with related teams to keep progress on track. In addition, I have a solid SEO foundation—especially in on-page optimization, keyword research, and improving organic visibility for articles. I work well independently, manage time effectively, and adapt quickly to both on-site and remote environments.
